description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of a channel pair, a coupling channel element and a fill element of SBR data, twelve times, in a stream of channel configuration 2, the coupling channel element switched independently in the odd blocks and dependently in the even ones and the data laid out as a channel pair's: the standard puts an SBR element after the independently switched element only, and reads it as a single channel element's (these bits happen to satisfy that reading); the payloads after the dependently switched one are reported and read by no one, and all count as evidence, so the stream is HE-AAC at 44100 Hz.
findings: 12 of 12 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC
6 raw data blocks hold SBR data that follows no single channel element, channel pair element or independently switched coupling channel element
12 raw data blocks hold a coupling channel element

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.ffprobe_streams: ffmpeg cannot decode the frames ("channel element 2.0 is not allocated"), so it reports no sample rate.
skip.decode: ffmpeg finds no channel for the coupling element in a stream of channel configuration 2.
skip.faad_trace: faad2 is built without coupling and stops at the element.
